dedupe_keys.name: census of gibraltar 2022 report with households by accommodation type tenure bedrooms and crowding cars motorcycles and parking spaces and method of travel to work by major residential area and enumeration area

description: HM Government of Gibraltar's Statistics Office published the report of the 2022 Census, held on 14 November 2022, as a long PDF on its statistics downloads page, next to census reports back to 1970. The housing chapter counts households and persons by accommodation type and tenure, with 4,798 households in government rented flats and 5,787 owner-occupied, and breaks them down by major residential area and census enumeration area by bedrooms, persons per room, household composition and the pre-war or post-war age of rented stock. Other tables count cars or vans, motorcycles and garages or parking spaces by area, and the employment chapter gives method of travel to work and working arrangement, including home working, by enumeration area. Coverage is national for the territory. Format and access: free PDF, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables sit in a 528-page PDF and some extract with broken spacing; there are no tables on water, energy or building materials in the table list read. Simulation uses: vehicle ownership, parking and commuting mode by area for a dense city, and housing tenure by area. Related records: none for Gibraltar in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Housing tables 189 to 235: households and persons by accommodation type and tenure (government rented, private rented, owner occupied, co-ownership, other, boat), by major residential area and enumeration area; cars or vans, motorcycles and garages or parking spaces per area; persons per room and bedrooms by area and tenure, including pre-war and post-war government and private rented stock; household composition. Employment tables 129 to 133: working arrangement and method of travel to work by enumeration area, nationality, age and sex.
